description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Lavabrink Floodgates and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Lavabrink Floodgates by tapping it, adding {R}{R}.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Lavabrink Floodgates and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Lavabrink Floodgates and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.
